messages:
elaine: customer reporting intermittent 502 / timeout when streaming completions. happens only through their EU proxy, not when they call directly. request_id: rq_0a1b2c3d. model: redwood-medium-2025. started at ~2026-03-16T14:30Z. asking for a curl repro to pass to infra.

rui: got it. can you paste the curl they tried (headers etc)? also ask for raw response body or proxy logs. common culprit: proxy stripping Transfer-Encoding or chunked framing.

elaine: here is the curl they gave (api key redacted):

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium-2025","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":256,"stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams
```
They say it works from curl on laptop but through corp proxy it returns 502 or sometimes the stream closes after a few tokens.

jamal: two quick asks for a proper repro we can run here:
1) capture the exact response headers (including any proxy-added ones) and response body for a failing run.
2) a curl that mimics their proxy behavior (if they add X-Forwarded-For or strip TE). Also ask them to try `--http1.1` and `--no-keepalive` to see if chunking changes.

rui: adding to jamal: please try this variant that forces chunked streaming and prints headers (so we can compare):

```
curl -v -N --http1.1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium-2025","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":256,"stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams
```
It will show response headers and how the stream frames look. If proxy rewrites TE or injects Connection: close that could explain truncation.

elaine: forwarded that and got back logs from their proxy team. they show the connection upgraded to http/1.1 but the proxy injects `Content-Length: 0` on the response and then closes. they attached proxy trace (large) and we have their network logs. asking if we want them to upload the debug bundle.

jamal: yes, request the debug bundle from the customer: include the failing request timestamp, curl command, `tcpdump` or `wireshark` pcap around the timestamp, and the proxy trace. In our side, get the request logs for rq_0a1b2c3d and the backend pod logs for that minute. I can pull server request/response raw for that request_id.

rui: while they compile bundle, try a quick local test to simulate proxy behavior: run a small HTTP proxy that adds `Content-Length: 0` and see if we can reproduce. if we can, we should add a mitigation doc. Also test with `--no-buffer` removed or `-N` kept; sometimes libcurl/chunked interactions differ.

elaine: customer uploaded debug bundle to S3 link (sanitized). proxy team confirmed they rewrite response headers due to legacy rule. they asked if Redwood can tolerate that or we should return non-chunked responses for that route.

jamal: we should not change streaming behavior globally. short-term: suggest they disable that proxy header rewrite for paths under /v1/streams, or use our websocket endpoint if available (which some proxies handle differently). I'll fetch the raw backend logs now for rq_0a1b2c3d.

infra-bot: pulled logs for request rq_0a1b2c3d: upstream returned 200 with chunked transfer, but proxy applied `Content-Length: 0` and closed connection at +1.8s. Full request log id: infra-log-7766.

rui: perfect — next steps: 1) share reproduction instructions to customer including the `curl -v --http1.1` command and ask them to run it and attach the full verbose output. 2) ask proxy team to stop injecting Content-Length for streamed responses or whitelist the /v1/streams path. 3) collect our server-side traces (I'll attach infra-log-7766 to the ticket).

elaine: sent reply with step-by-step and asked them to run the verbose curl and to upload the pcap/debug bundle. marking follow-up in 24h. :thumbsup:
